newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil CVRD sale still blocked.
newsitem.headline: Brazil CVRD sale still blocked.

text.p: Two or three injunctions are still blocking the sale of Brazilian mining giant Companhia Vale do Rio Doce (CVRD), said Jose Pio Borges, privatization director of the National Development Bank (BNDES).
"Tomorrow perhaps we will have good news," Borges told reporters, adding that government lawyers would work to contest those injunctions after the courts opened at 11 a.m. (1400 GMT).
Borges said the BNDES would publish a notice on Tuesday officially rescheduling the auction of 45 percent of CVRD's voting shares at the Rio de Janeiro bourse for Tuesday.
Earlier, a judge at the Superior Court of Justice (STJ) in Brasilia granted a government appeal against a host of outstanding injunctions.
But Borges said the ruling did not apply to two or three new injunctions -- two in Rio and one he could give no details on.
He said the government might contest all those injunctions at a federal court in Rio or request the STJ to extend its ruling to all the injunctions.
Officials would decide the best course of action Tuesday, he said.
The sale of CVRD, which would be Latin America's biggest privatization to date, was originally due to have kicked off April 29 but has been repeatedly delayed by court injunctions.
